title: RightDerivedSingleUnitHomologyComparison
statement: Let B and C be abelian categories with derived categories and enough injectives in B [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. For any additive G : B → C and Y in B, define u_G(Y) : G(Y)[0] → R⁺G(Y[0]) by the right-derived unit on the homotopy single complex, transported by the canonical single-complex isomorphisms. Define a⁺_G(Y) by composing the inverse of H⁰(G(Y)[0]) ≅ G(Y) with H⁰(u_G(Y)). Under the single-complex comparison H⁰(R⁺G(Y[0])) ≅ R⁰G(Y) [lem-sp-derived-functor-single-identification], a⁺_G(Y) is the classical augmentation toRightDerivedZero(Y) [lem-weil-pbc-left-exact-injective-resolution-degree-zero]. No left exactness assumption on G is needed.

source.place: Tag 05TD, part (3); the defining derived unit equation and single-complex comparisons in PlusBaseChange.lean and PlusSingle.lean.

proof.text: Expand the single-complex comparison using the chosen injective resolution. Naturality of the derived unit along its augmentation cancels the unit on the injective resolution against the inverse used by the comparison.

Transport the remaining resolution augmentation through homologyFunctorObjQIso and the natural-number to integer-complex homology comparison. In degree zero this is the cycles lift toRightDerivedZero' followed by isoHomologyπ₀ and isoRightDerivedObj.inv, precisely the classical augmentation.
